evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet spend and PSBT signing logic across src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp and src/psbt.cpp.
rationale: Allows Taproot users to prevent unnecessary script-path signing and metadata leakage. The PR description notes that default wallet behavior when spending from Taproot descriptors with fallback scripts "wastes fees, harms privacy by unnecessarily exposing fallback scripts, can trigger firmware bugs in external signing devices, and risks accidental broadcast of fallback paths."
